item.title: Aptos girls’ soccer clinches fourth straight SCCAL crown | Weeklys Sports Roundup

item.title: Padilla, Schiff secure $54M for Pajaro River Levee
item.description: U.S. Sen. Alex Padilla announced Tuesday that he and Sen. Adam Schiff secured $54 million in federal funding for the Pajaro River Flood Risk Management Project, aimed at strengthening flood protection for Watsonville and Pajaro.
